1:48:00 strategy 2 cup and handle
V40&v40next
3% and no stoploss, depth of cup should be 40%
It is same as reverse head and shoulder without left shoulder
In this case, technical Target is the selling price
Cup can be any shape and can have multiple handles. More handles means more reliability.
Cup must be deeper than handle
Buy point will be breakout of base formation of handle with close of green handle on daily basis of first handle.
If base is too small, look for a larger base
